'''Royalty''' go by different titles in different lands; the unifying factor is that they control an extensive territory and are generally seen as having no one in authority over them; occasionally a High King such as [[Artur Hawkwing]] will have other kings and queens in [[wikipedia:fealty|fealty]] to them, but this is rare. 

People listed here are those royal persons who do not currently rule nations, i.e. princes and princesses, those who no long have a country to rule, or those whose title has been taken from them.
